scope: Canonical full-clear encounter order from the first trainer battle through the current authored frontier. This frontier grows continuously until every campaign, optional, rematch, boss, and postgame trainer encounter in the 810-definition guide is assigned exactly once.
ordering_rule: Use the earliest natural first-playthrough path. Optional trainers are never dropped. Mutually exclusive gender, starter, or partner branches of one physical encounter are grouped under one battle index. Where open terrain or an open side route permits reversal, one order is selected and the ambiguity is documented. Rustboro Gym is canonicalized before the already-accessible Route 116 so each cap-relative encounter has one authored first-reach state.

entries.access_note: One physical rival encounter; the six source records and 21 runtime starter counterparts are mutually exclusive branches.
First east-to-west Route 102 sight trainer. His fixed line of sight is a route choke for a normal two-healthy-Pokémon party; the native doubles guard is the only non-battle pass condition.
Second east-to-west Route 102 sight trainer.
Third east-to-west Route 102 sight trainer.
Final Route 102 sight trainer before Petalburg.
First northbound Route 104 south trainer.
Talk-initiated fisherman immediately north of Billy.
Last Route 104 south sight trainer before entering Petalburg Woods.
First natural south-to-north Woods sight trainer; rotating facing makes him avoidable.
Mandatory Devon researcher ambush. The two trigger directions share one trainer record.
North-Woods sight trainer after the mandatory Aqua encounter.
Nearest trainer on the canonical full-clear path after the Woods north exit.
Open terrain permits Haley and Winston to be reversed; Winston-first is the canonical full-clear order.
Two overworld twins share one doubles encounter and therefore one index.
Talk-initiated northern fisherman before Rustboro; fully optional.

First central-aisle Gym Trainer on the natural south-entry path; sight-triggered but bypassable through an outer lane. Route 116 is physically open, but Gym-first is the canonical cap-14 full-clear branch.
Optional west-side Youngster detour inside the Gym; indexed before the deeper west-side Hiker.
Optional west-side Hiker and deliberate singles pacing battle before the Leader.
Stone Badge boss and final cap-14 encounter; Route 116 follows at the new cap of 20 in the canonical order.
First west-entry sight trainer on Route 116. The route was physically accessible before Roxanne, but Gym-first canon fixes Joey's first authored state at the new strict cap of 20.
Bug Catcher on the lower west approach, selected second in the canonical full-clear Route 116 sweep; open terrain permits local reversal with later west-side trainers.
First central Route 116 schoolchild in the canonical west-to-east sweep; rematches are separate later encounters.

Canonical 3+3 native double at the central coordinate intersection. Either trainer can be split into an independent three-Pokémon single. Current fixed sight geometry pairs Clark with Johnson; Devan's separate west-facing line does not intersect Johnson's south-facing line.
Eastern Hiker preserved as a standalone double after selecting Clark+Johnson at the ambiguous central intersection.
First Cut-grove coordinate intersection in the canonical west-to-east clear. The joint fight loads three Pokémon per trainer, while either half can be approached as an independent single.
Second Cut-grove coordinate intersection. The joint fight is a 3+3 double; either trainer can also be split into a self-sufficient three-Pokémon single.
Mandatory Peeko and Devon Goods recovery battle. Mike remains inaccessible beyond the Rock Smash blockage.
One optional physical rival battle inside a mandatory post-Devon conversation. Gender, starter, and Rustboro-versus-Route104 location records are mutually exclusive runtime branches.
First east-to-west shore trainer from Dewford. Route 105 cannot be disembarked and Route 106 swimmers Douglas and Kyla require Surf, so they are not yet reachable.
Second reachable Route 106 shore trainer and intentional singles pacing before Dewford Gym; later Match Call stages are separate encounters.
First canonical Gym branch trainer after the player completes the no-battle Steven letter event in Granite Cave and receives the Mega Bracelet; the two interior branches are reversible.
East-branch native 3+3 double. Either trainer can also be split into an independently viable three-Pokémon single.
First west-branch singles lesson after the canonical east-branch clear.
Second west-branch singles lesson before the final Gym trainer.
Final optional Gym double immediately before Brawly.
Required Knuckle Badge boss at strict cap 20 after Steven grants the Mega Bracelet but before departing for Slateport; victory raises the cap to 30.
First trainer on the canonical northbound beach clear after Briney lands at Route 109. The optional southern loop remains reachable and will be indexed after the direct beach approach.
Next northbound beach trainer after Huey on the canonical Route 109 approach toward Slateport; Hailey's long sight line makes her the next natural contact.
East-side sailor on the same northbound beach band after Hailey; retained as a singles pacing battle before the final approach trainers.
First north-edge Tuber on the direct Route 109 approach after Edmond; Match Call rematches remain separate future encounters.
North-edge Tuber immediately after Ricky on the canonical beach approach; later Match Call stages remain separate encounters.
Final north-edge youngster after Lola on the direct Route 109 approach before entering Slateport proper.

First chosen encounter inside the foot-accessible Seashore House on Route 109's main beach. Dwayne, Johanna, and Simon may be challenged in different orders; Dwayne is canonicalized first, and defeating all three unlocks the shared six-Soda-Pop reward and Soda Pop shop.
Second canonical Seashore House challenge. The room permits a different player-selected order, but all three independent trainer flags feed one retry-safe completion callback.
Third canonical Seashore House challenge and final contributor to the shared completion flag. The owner awards six Soda Pops only after Dwayne, Johanna, and Simon have all been defeated.

First mandatory museum ambush after delivering the Devon Goods to Captain Stern. This no-intro battle begins a three-fight scripted Aqua sequence; the player receives no automatic healing before the second Grunt.
Second mandatory Grunt attacks immediately after the first Grunt's defeat dialogue and movement, with no party heal or normal preparation window between the two battles.

Archie enters after both Grunts. The native script explicitly heals the player's party before this boss battle, so Archie is designed as a fresh maximum-difficulty fight rather than the third leg of the Grunt attrition check.

First trainer encounter after the Museum clears Route 110. Isabel at (10,76) and Kaleb at (7,76) have intersecting two-tile sight lines across the only ground corridor, producing a native 3+3 two-opponent double when the player has at least two usable Pokémon. Each source record remains independently reachable if the other has already been defeated.

First Puzzle 1 trainer after the Route 110 pair. Sally is always first and geometrically unavoidable during a normal completion: her six-tile sight line crosses the only route out of the entrance region. Her defeat flag is not checked by the scroll, door, or Mental Herb reward.

Required within optional Puzzle 1 by current collision geometry, but not by a script flag. Eddie's two-tile sight line crosses every exit approach. Eddie and Robin may be fought in either order after Sally; Eddie is the canonical guide tie-break only.

Required within optional Puzzle 1 by current collision geometry, but not by a script flag. Robin's two-tile sight line crosses every scroll approach. Robin and Eddie may be fought in either order after Sally; the Mental Herb reward itself depends only on puzzle state.
Optional eastern Route 110 detour near the Trick House latitude. It may be cleared before or after Puzzle 1; puzzle-first is the canonical full-clear choice.

Mandatory three-tile coordinate-triggered rival milestone before Mauville. Player gender and starter element choose one of six records, while source slot three dynamically becomes the same-generation middle counter-starter across all seven supported trios. Loss cleanly retriggers state 0; victory awards the Itemfinder and keeps the cap at 30.

Ground-road Edwin at (34,40) faces right four tiles and Joseph at (36,40) faces left three tiles; their shared trigger at (35,40) creates a native 3+3 pair when both are undefeated and the player has two usable Pokémon. Either surviving trainer remains independently fightable. Edwin owns the Match Call chain; Joseph has no rematch or item reward.

Edward at (3,39) and Alyssa at (10,39) face each other across the six-tile corridor, producing a deterministic native pair when entered between them. Either can run independently if the other is already defeated or the player has only one usable Pokémon. Neither owns a rematch or scripted reward.
Optional ground-road detour at (10,19), facing down one tile. Dale uses one independent trainer script and has no rematch, callback, or item reward.
Optional northern ground-road detour at (33,15), facing left one tile. Jaclyn follows Dale in the south-to-north full-clear order and has no rematch, callback, or item reward.

First canonical Cycling Road clear after obtaining a Bike in Mauville. Anthony moves through a broad box around (19,31), while Abigail faces left from (30,31); joint pairing depends on Anthony's live position and facing, so the dossier must support both joint and split branches. Abigail owns a Match Call chain; Anthony does not.
Moving Cycling Road trainer centered at (16,55) with three-tile sight. Benjamin owns a Match Call rematch chain but no direct item reward.
Moving Cycling Road trainer centered at (16,73) with a long vertical route and three-tile sight. Jasmine has no rematch, callback, or direct item reward.

Southern moving Cycling Road trainer centered at (21,78) with two-tile sight. Jacob has no rematch or direct item reward. Cycling course rating independently awards Electric Seed or Quick Claw and is not gated by trainer victories.

Script-driven Wally scene at the Mauville Gym doorway. The player may initially decline, but victory sets FLAG_DEFEATED_WALLY_MAUVILLE, moves Wally and his uncle, enables the later call, and physically clears the Gym entrance. No item reward or automatic cap change occurs.
